{
  "verdict": "revise",
  "score": 0.65,
  "reasons": [
    "No reference list with URLs and one-sentence annotations is included; the instruction requires a sources section with annotated URLs.",
    "The document is truncated mid-sentence in the 'Recent trends and notable breakthroughs' section: ends with 'signaling a path to' and should be completed.",
    "Some statements lack explicit citations or source mapping (e.g., module efficiency ranges, lab vs real-world figures); add citations after each claim or in a dedicated references section.",
    "The artifact should fully meet the 2–3 page concise format; verify length and ensure the 'reference list' component is present and properly formatted."
  ],
  "guidance": "To revise: 1) Add a 'References' section containing URLs to peer‑reviewed papers, NREL/IEA/Fraunhofer reports, manufacturer datasheets, and reputable industry sources, with a one‑sentence annotation for each source. 2) Complete the truncated sentence and expand the 'Recent trends and notable breakthroughs' with concise bullet points (e.g., perovskite tandems >30%, tandem approaches, bifacial modules, tracker economics). 3) Explicitly map claims to sources (typical efficiencies by technology, record vs real-world, degradation, temperature coefficients) and ensure consistency between cells, modules, and system-level yields. 4) Ensure the 2–3 page length by tightening prose and removing redundancies, and clearly separate residential vs commercial ranges. 5) Include a short conclusion and a figure/table placeholder note if needed."
}
